Wolfe's *"Notes on Midtraining"* essay canonicalizes midtraining as distinct training-pipeline stage, with Cursor Composer 2 (CPT + RL on Kimi-K2.5 base) as the canonical landing example. - **ByteDance + OpenAI Doug twin frontier-scale pre-training runs in progress mark a return to raw-scaling investment**: After ~18 months of frontier-lab emphasis on post-training + RL + inference-time compute, the *simultaneous OpenAI Doug + ByteDance 10T* pre-training announcements suggest raw-scaling capital investment is returning to primacy.
